scripts.push: bash -c 'if [ -n "$DATABASE_URL" ] || [ -n "$NEON_DATABASE_URL" ]; then timeout 20 drizzle-kit push --config ./drizzle.config.ts || echo "DB push timed out or failed — skipping"; else echo "No DATABASE_URL — skipping push"; fi'
scripts.push-force: bash -c 'if [ -n "$DATABASE_URL" ] || [ -n "$NEON_DATABASE_URL" ]; then timeout 20 drizzle-kit push --force --config ./drizzle.config.ts || echo "DB push timed out or failed — skipping"; else echo "No DATABASE_URL — skipping push"; fi'
